title: 三联曲面展厅
method: GPT Image reference-based generation or local edit
prompt: Create ONE static gallery concept image. Image1 is AUTHORITATIVE for the exact three-panel spatial layout and perspective curvature. Image2 supplies only the beautiful golden architecture/ball artwork and warm material mood. Match image1's composition carefully: black void stage, subdued perspective floor grid, generous black top space; a horizontal track with THREE large curved artwork panels. CENTER panel fully visible, LEFT and RIGHT panels only partially visible and cropped by viewport sides. Center panel spans about x23% to71%, y25% to75% of whole image. Crucial: its LEFT half is NEAR camera, taller and wider; its RIGHT half recedes into distance, narrower and vertically compressed. Left edge extends from y26% to75%, right edge from y30% to68%. Upper and lower edges curve smoothly in space, not straight trapezoid edges. The top edge gently rises from left then bends downward toward receding right, bottom edge bends upward toward the receding right. This is an asymmetrical oblique cylindrical ribbon, NOT a symmetrical concave screen, NOT a centered frontal curved TV, NOT three flat cards. Keep the gaps between center and neighbors narrow, as reference1. Left cropped panel fills x0–23% with dim charcoal artwork; right cropped panel x72–100% with a pale editorial photo composition. The central artwork is the warm amber architectural scene from image2, with one golden orb and round stone pool, tastefully integrated 'Solstice' large italic serif type within the central screen, following its perspective. Keep the entire central panel visible, and reduce its width from image2 so neighbors have space. Subtle warm reflection on dark floor, not a bright mirror. No outside headings, no fake browser frame, no extra labels, no UI controls. Aspect ratio matches reference1 landscape. Faithful spatial study, not a new layout.
limitations: 用户明确暂停HTML。仅静态效果通过；真实曲面几何、滑动、响应式、键盘导航及性能未验证。中心面板相较参考略宽、地面反射略强。
license: Reference website assets remain with their respective rights holders; this generated study is retained for private design research. Commercial reuse clearance has not been established.
text_prompt: Edit this image only to add three tiny restrained white text accents in the surrounding black space. Keep every panel, curvature, left-near/right-far perspective, artwork, lighting and floor grid unchanged. At upper left x5%, y4% add 'SELECTED WORKS' in tiny neutral uppercase sans-serif, around9 pixels high on a1566-wide canvas, weight medium, near-white. At upper right, right-aligned x95%, y4%, add 'PROFILE' same tiny style. At bottom left x5%, y96%, add 'FEATURED / FULL' same tiny style, with FULL slightly dimmer. These must stay very small, like peripheral gallery metadata, not headings or buttons. No boxes or icons. Do not enlarge the labels. Preserve entire image and aspect ratio.
